name: EPIC 246204419

text.card: A red giant 5,562 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.91 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,892 K at its surface.
